hypothesis: Cycling 4096-point balanced blocks through the exact dense pool retains persistent structure at one sixteenth of dense point presentations. Coverage over successive updates, rather than repeatedly fitting a fixed sparse pool, may explain the improvement over the historical static 4096-point failure.
prior_result: Batch 1 audited: 16384 cycling retained 6/6 persistent structural passes; training-time ratio 0.38582686045188735 and presentation ratio 0.25 versus contemporary dense rerun. Both later checkpoints passed all RMSE, sign and surface-distance guardrails. All 18 dense model/Adam checkpoints reproduced exactly.
controls: Same six 20000-update model/Adam states, exact dense pools, ordinary MSE, architecture, 10000-update cosine schedule, checkpoint times, independent probes and unchanged 192/384 structural gate. Compare with audited batch-1 dense and 16384 cycling; preserve the historical fixed-4096 result (0/6 persistent) as contextual evidence. Dense timing is from batch 1, so later timing comparisons are sequential and not a controlled speed benchmark.
decision_criteria: Unchanged: all six trajectories pass at both 26000 and 30000 and both resolutions; aggregate training time <=0.90 of batch-1 dense; presentations below dense. At BOTH later checkpoints, mean Chamfer at each grid <=1.05 times dense, mean independent gap RMSE <=1.10 times dense, and mean full-gap sign accuracy no more than 0.5 percentage points below dense. Missing meshes fail; retain all seeds and regressions. These are descriptive development guardrails, not statistical noninferiority tests.
pairing: All arms share initial model/Adam and saved original RNG with their corresponding seed and sampler; sampling stream changes intentionally. Sixteen disjoint 4096-point balanced blocks cycle in fixed order; each contains exactly 2048 original, 1024 gap and 1024 facing-interior points. Pool/evaluation disjointness checked. No points selected using evaluation residuals.
budget: Batch 1 charged 1472.3278015000105 seconds. At most one further batch after this, and cumulative additional training/evaluation below 7200 seconds. Entire subprocess wall time charged conservatively; small verification fixture tests reported separately. Hard timeout and retained partial results remain enabled.
scope: Development geometry and existing seeds only; fresh cases remain reserved. All 65536 labels and their storage retained. Report continuation compute only; common preceding 20000 updates are excluded from savings. Cycling confounds exposure order and gradient noise.
next_decision: If 4096 cycling qualifies, batch 3 will challenge its dependence on fixed block phase using a one-block phase shift, with no new training seeds.
